text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up  new Eng Manager Sam starts Mon 10:00 PT. Dropping a compact, practical manager onboarding checklist + week-1 rhythm. Please ack the items you own by EOD Fri.

Priya (People Ops): Day-before essentials (one-liner each):
- Device shipped with dev image
- Okta invite + MFA link sent
- Slack + email + calendar created
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers & hiring folder
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome email with first-week expectations sent

Diego (IT): Device is imaged (MacBook Pro), shipping label created. Will add Docker, VSCode, chrome extensions, and set up VPN profile. Quick Q: which cluster group? `eng-dev` only?

Hannah (Eng): Start with `eng-dev`. We'll evaluate `eng-prod` after 30d. I'll handle kubeconfig and add Sam to the oncall rotation doc later.

Maya (People Ops): Minimal week-1 manager flow I recommend (short):
Mon 10:00 - intro w/ People Ops (10m) + team kickoff (30m)
Tue - buddy shadow + infra runthrough (60m)
Wed - product + PM context (30m)
Thu - 30/60/90 draft + hiring conversation (45m)
Fri - skip-level intro + week1 retro (30m)

Priya (People Ops): 30/60/90 framing we ask managers to bring (bullet):
- 30d: meet crew, learn core services, ship a docs or small infra tweak
- 60d: lead a planning session, propose two operational improvements
- 90d: own a roadmap slice and a hiring/mentoring plan

Hannah (Eng): Also add a 20m "team norms & sprint cadence" with tech leads on Tue morning. Saves a lot of back-and-forth later.

Diego (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged & shipped. Will post tracking when label scans. VPN + dev image apps installed.

Priya (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Welcome email queued (includes required trainings: security basics, data handling, manager anti-bias).

Hannah (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + infra session confirmed. I'll prepare a tiny onboarding PR task so Sam has a hands-on win in week 1.

Maya (People Ops): Who-to-ask cheat-sheet (short):
- Payroll & comp: Priya
- Hardware & access: Diego
- Infra & cluster: Hannah / platform channel
- Security & compliance: eng-security channel

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Sam - prestart checklist" scheduled Fri 17:00 PT.

Sam (new-hire): Thanks all  appreciate the clarity. Quick ask: can someone point me to the hiring rubric before Thu's hiring convo?

Priya (People Ops): Sent hiring rubric link in DM. Also added the recruiter meeting in the Thu block.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is complete. I'll publish a short Notion page with the final timeline and links and DM Sam the week-1 calendar."
